name: Mary Jones | 100mg Soda | Orange & Cream
description:
Same Jones.
More Mary.
More flavors, higher dosages, only available in dispensaries.

Mary Jones’ Orange and Cream is a luxurious fusion of juicy, sun-kissed oranges and silky cream, creating a dreamy, indulgent flavor. It’s a perfect treat for those who savor a sweet, comforting embrace in every sip.
